_comment: The one combination worth trying: velocity 2x (the confirmed fix) with d_model 1024 (the only non-loss axis that moved the shared profile). Their mechanisms differ - one constrains what the rollout may do, the other gives the head room to make each segment flight-specific - so they may compose. Both singles are already measured on the same cohort (velocity 2x: 17.3 % shared / +0.197 skill / 317.7 m median ADE; wide: 48.8 % / -0.000 / 343.9 m), which is what makes one arm sufficient to read composition.
